plan.goal: Exhaustively explore and critique the FRED Unemployment Rate clone, focusing on data visualization interactions, graph controls, and responsive behavior.
plan.summary: The exploration will start by assessing the default page state, including the maintenance banner and overall layout. It will heavily focus on interacting with the main chart, adjusting date ranges, and toggling data views. Subsequent phases will delve into the 'Edit Graph' functionality and validate metadata and footer links. Finally, the run will re-evaluate critical chart controls and navigation on a mobile viewport due to flagged small tap targets.
assumptions: The chart is interactive and responds to hover events to display tooltips.
The time range buttons (1Y, 5Y, etc.) and date inputs dynamically update the chart.
The 'Edit Graph' button opens a panel or modal with further configuration tabs ('EDIT LINE', 'ADD LINE', 'FORMAT').
The 'View as data table' button swaps the chart for a tabular data representation.
risk_hotspots: Chart hover interactions and tooltip rendering
State transitions when toggling between 'Chart' and 'View as data table'
Usability of small tap targets (header links, breadcrumbs) on mobile devices
The 'Edit Graph' configuration panel's layout and functionality

phases.title: Initial State & Global Navigation
phases.objective: Verify the default layout, dismiss the maintenance banner, and test basic header navigation/search.
key_checks: Click the 'Close maintenance notice' button and ensure it dismisses.
Interact with the 'Search FRED Data' input.
Verify the breadcrumb links are clickable.
exit_criteria: Banner is dismissed and header elements are confirmed interactive.

phases.title: Chart Controls & Data Views
phases.objective: Thoroughly test the main data visualization interactions and range filters.
key_checks: Click the '1Y', '5Y', '10Y', and 'Max' buttons to observe chart updates.
Enter valid and invalid date formats into the 'From' and 'To' input fields.
Hover over the chart area to trigger and observe tooltips.
Toggle between 'Chart' and 'View as data table' tabs.
exit_criteria: All time-range controls are tested, and the data table view is successfully toggled.

phases.title: Edit Graph & Actions
phases.objective: Explore the 'Edit Graph' panel and other primary action buttons.
key_checks: Navigate through the 'EDIT LINE', 'ADD LINE', and 'FORMAT' tabs if they appear.
Click the 'Download' button and observe the resulting state (dropdown or action).
exit_criteria: The Edit Graph panel is fully explored and Download options are revealed.

phases.title: Metadata & Recommendations
phases.objective: Validate the secondary content blocks, metadata accuracy, and footer interactions.
key_checks: Scroll to and inspect the 'Notes', 'Release Tables', and 'Related Data and Content' sections.
Attempt to interact with tags or suggested series links.
Fill out and submit the newsletter subscription email input.
exit_criteria: Secondary content is reviewed and the newsletter form is tested.

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Assess the responsive design, focusing on chart scaling and flagged small tap targets.
key_checks: Verify the main chart scales correctly without horizontal scrolling.
Test header navigation and breadcrumbs to evaluate the small tap target warnings.
Operate the time-range controls and 'Edit Graph' on mobile.
exit_criteria: Chart is usable on mobile and tap targets are evaluated for usability.

coverage_targets.features: Exercise all chart controls (range, view toggle, edit panel) and global actions (search, download).
coverage_targets.mobile: Ensure the chart, date inputs, and 'Edit Graph' controls are functional and readable on a narrow screen.

notes: Since the data is mock (via data.js), focus on the UI state changes rather than the absolute accuracy of the data points.
Pay special attention to how the 'Edit Graph' area manages space, as it often opens as an accordion or side panel in the real FRED app.
